story_type: mudslide rooftop hoist, man, girl and dog
hook: A mudslide hit their house. A girl and a dog were inside.
narration: A mudslide swept over their house. A man, a young girl and a dog were still there.
This was Santa Barbara County, California, on January ninth, 2018.
Thick mud had poured through the neighborhood, around the houses and the trees.
There was no way out on the ground. The only way out was up.
A Coast Guard Dolphin helicopter came in from Forward Operating Base Point Mugu.
The rescue basket is a metal cage with floats. Survivors climb in and sit, and the flight mechanic reels it up on the cable.
The crew lowered the basket down to the roof.
[short pause] The first rider came up to the door.
Last came the man, with the dog in the basket beside him.
outcome: The crew lifted all three out and flew them to a staging area with county emergency crews.
title: Girl and dog lifted out of a mudslide
description:
On Jan. 9, 2018, a Coast Guard MH-65 Dolphin crew from Forward Operating Base Point Mugu hoisted a man, a young girl and a dog from their home in Santa Barbara County, California, after a mudslide overtook the house.
